question: Should workflow completion integrations use the typed plugin `session_end` hook exclusively, or should HOOK.md hook packs also receive a separate internal `session:end` event?
rationale: OpenClaw intentionally documents typed plugin hooks and internal hook packs as different extension products, and overlapping lifecycle contracts require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Standardize on plugin lifecycle
options.body: Complete typed `session_end` coverage for the intended completion paths and document code plugins as the supported workflow-integration surface.

options.title: Add a hook-pack lifecycle event
options.body: Define internal `session:end` as a separate coarse automation contract with explicit end semantics, payload guarantees, and comprehensive dispatch tests.

recommendation.title: Standardize on plugin lifecycle
recommendation.body: Complete typed `session_end` coverage for the intended completion paths and document code plugins as the supported workflow-integration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest current history across both internal and plugin lifecycle owner files and participated in the prior issue-level decision.
